books.title: Star Hunter
books.author: Andre Norton
books.summary: On the unexplored jungle world of Jumala the sole survivor of a spaceship crash is heir to a fortune, or has been made to believe so.

books.title: The Tower Treasure
books.author: Franklin W. Dixon
books.summary: After a tower mansion is robbed, two boys are determined to find the culprit and exonerate their friend’s father.

books.title: The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin
books.author: Benjamin Franklin
books.summary: Benjamin Franklin writes about his youth, adventures, and achievements.

books.title: Recollections of Full Years

books.summary: Helen Herron Taft, wife of William Howard Taft, the twenty-seventh President of the United States, recalls her life married to one of America’s most influential political figures.

books.title: Our Baseball Club and How It Won the Championship
books.author: Noah Brooks
books.summary: A late-19th century Illinois baseball team journeys to compete for the championship.

books.title: The Cords of Vanity

books.summary: An arrogant young author makes his way through a series of love affairs, avoiding every situation that may cause unpleasantness.

books.title: Henry V

books.summary: Shakespeare’s 1599 play chronicling the history of King Henry the Fifth and his famous victory over the French at the Battle of Agincourt.

books.title: The Roots of the Mountains

books.summary: The peoples of the dales and woods must unite to defeat a foe intent on enslaving them.

books.title: The Napoleon of Notting Hill

books.summary: A satire set in far-future London where the king, who was chosen at random, only cares about a good joke.

books.title: The Dark Other
books.author: Stanley G. Weinbaum
books.summary: A young woman seeks the reason behind her lover’s outbursts of cruelty.

books.title: The Storm of Steel
books.author: Ernst Jünger
books.summary: A German storm troop officer recounts his experiences in World War I.

books.title: The Box Office Murders

books.summary: The discovery of a drowned woman sets the police on the trail of a mysterious scam involving cinema cashiers.

books.summary: American archetype and cultural founding father P. T. Barnum shares a collection of anecdotes that he deems “humbugs”—fodder for the gullible, deserving of skepticism—with the goal of making his fellow citizens a little wiser and more skeptical.

books.title: The Social Contract
books.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

books.title: Poetry

books.author: Ring Lardner
books.summary: A police detective attempts to live the American dream in the Chicago suburbs.

books.title: Plague of Pythons

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: Akutagawa Ryūnosuke
books.summary: A collection of short fiction by Akutagawa Ryūnosuke, ordered by date of publication.

books.title: Paradise Lost

books.title: Travel Essays
